Resolves #21765

Routes `pointercancel` terminals arriving at `Neo.main.addon.DragDrop#onDragEnd` through `cancelDrag` (`type: 'drag:cancel'` + `dragResize.cancel()`, with a zoneless fallback when `dragZoneId` is unset) instead of forwarding `drag:end` + `drop` or committing an active resize, and wires `drag:cancel` + `dragZone#dragCancel` release handlers across the consumers that previously terminated gestures only in `'drag:end'` DOM listeners (`Neo.dialog.Base`, `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow`, `Neo.calendar.view.week.plugin.DragDrop`, and `Neo.calendar.view.month.plugin.DragDrop`).

Evidence: L3 (trusted CDP `Input.dispatchTouchEvent` `touchCancel`/`touchEnd` on `examples/board/basic` and `examples/dialog` + `DragDrop`/`Pointer`/`Overflow`/`WeekView`/`MonthView` unit & `DockSplitterIframePane` component suites) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-3). No residuals.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; change-class `restoration` (`fix`), local `check-class-module-scope`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-file-sizes`, and `check-engine-brain-boundary` ran (`OK`).
Ticket intake: `#21765` (`valid-as-written`, `pre-stale`); Core-Idiom Pre-Flight (`src/Neo.mjs`, `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/state/Provider.mjs`), `onDragCancel` zone overrides, and `'drag:end'` DOM-listener consumer release paths verified; Prescription checked: `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs` — owns the shared boundary, with release wiring on the four `'drag:end'`-only DOM consumers.

| AC | Verification |
|---|----------------|
| AC-1 | CI-covered + local exact-head receipts in `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs` (trusted CDP `touchCancel` over `Ready` keeps card `1` at `{status: 'backlog', order: 1000}`, emits `0` `cardMove` events, removes `.neo-dragproxy`, and releases capture) and `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MoveResize.spec.mjs` (header `touchCancel` keeps initial dialog coordinates and restores `opacity: 1`). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered + local exact-head receipt in `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs`: an immediate follow-up trusted touch gesture on the same path ending in `touchEnd` arms cleanly and commits card `1` to `Ready` with `1` `cardMove`. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered in `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MoveResize.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/main/addon/DragDrop.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/main/draggable/sensor/Pointer.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/calendar/WeekView.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/calendar/MonthView.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockSplitterIframePane.spec.mjs`. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Guarded zoneless `pointercancel` (`dragZoneId === null`) in `DragDrop#onDragEnd` so active main-thread resizes cancel and `drag:cancel` still dispatches with `parsedEvent` even before first-gesture `setConfigs` zone registration lands.
- Wired `'drag:cancel'` DOM listeners and `dragZone#dragCancel` release handlers on `dialog/Base` (restoring `style.opacity = me.dragStartOpacity ?? null` and aborting in-flight `dragStart`), `tab/plugin/Overflow` (releasing `'overflow-tab-press'`), `calendar/view/week/plugin/DragDrop` (resetting `isDragging`, `EventResizable`, and provisional column `New Event` records), and `calendar/view/month/plugin/DragDrop` (resetting `isDragging` and zoneless proxy teardown).

  - `MoveResize.spec.mjs` (`#21765` touch-cancel arm) at `beb96c739a`: failed (`Expected: "1"`, `Received: "0.7"`) → `5/5` passed (`12.1s`).
  - `Overflow.spec.mjs` (`#21765`), `WeekView.spec.mjs` (`#21765`), and `MonthView.spec.mjs` (`#2334`) at `beb96c739a`: failed on unreleased `overflow-tab-press` (`Received: true`) and `plugin.isDragging` (`Received: true`) → `155/155` passed across `Overflow`, `WeekView`, `MonthView`, `DragDrop`, and `Pointer` unit suites (`3.3s`).
